item.name: Auth
item.description: Login sync and profile endpoints. Call POST /sync after every Clerk login from the frontend.

request.description: Call this after any Clerk sign-in (Google, or Clerk native phone-number/SMS auth), and after phone-OTP signup/login complete the Clerk sign-in with the returned signInToken. Verifies the Clerk JWT, fetches the full Clerk profile, upserts the MongoDB record, and returns the full profile. If Clerk reports the phone as verified (native phone_code strategy, or a phone verified via Clerk frontend SDK), phoneVerified/phoneVerifiedAt are stamped here too (upgrade-only, never regresses an already-verified phone). Also stamps publicMetadata.role in Clerk if missing. 400 EMAIL_REQUIRED if the Clerk user has no email at all. 409 EXISTING_USER on an email collision with a different Clerk identity (with conditional cleanup of the duplicate). 409 PHONE_IN_USE if Clerk's phone for this user already belongs to a different account.

request.description: New-account signup, step 1. Normalizes phone to E.164, rejects if the email/phone is already registered (DB) or the email exists in Clerk, then sends a 6-digit WhatsApp OTP. Rate-limited per-IP; the per-phone resend cooldown (30s) and hourly cap (3) are enforced in lib/otpAuth.js. isNRI and marketingOptIn are optional (default false) and are applied atomically when the account is created in signup/verify.

response.name: 409 – Already Registered
response.body: {"success":false,"message":"An account with this email or phone already exists.","data":{"code":"ALREADY_REGISTERED"}}

response.name: 429 – Send Limit
response.body: {"success":false,"message":"Too many codes requested. Try again in an hour.","data":{"code":"OTP_SEND_LIMIT"}}

request.description: Signup step 2. On success, creates the Clerk user (generated username + strong random password), creates the DB row (phoneVerified: true), and returns a short-lived (60s) signInToken for the frontend to complete Clerk sign-in with. If DB creation fails after the Clerk user was created, the Clerk user is rolled back automatically.
Existing-account login, step 1. 404 ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND if no user has this phone — the frontend should redirect to signup on that response. Otherwise sends a 6-digit WhatsApp OTP.

Login step 2. Checks the account is not suspended and is role USER (a PARTNER/ADMIN account gets a 403 WRONG_PORTAL instead — the frontend should route them to the correct portal). On success returns a 60s signInToken.

response.name: 403 – Wrong Portal
response.body: {"success":false,"message":"This account is registered as PARTNER. Please use the correct portal to sign in.","data":{"code":"WRONG_PORTAL","role":"PARTNER"}}

request.description: Self-service upgrade from USER to PARTNER. Only PARTNER can be self-assigned. Idempotent — if already PARTNER or ADMIN, returns current role.
Returns the full DB profile for the authenticated user including unread notification count and active subscription. Works for all roles (USER, PARTNER, ADMIN).
Cheap re-check of whether the current user has completed onboarding (verified phone), without a full /sync round-trip. Used after the Google phone-completion step, or on app resume.

Authenticated. Called after a Google sign-in whose onboarding is incomplete (see Sync User on Login / Get Onboarding Status). Rejects if this account already has a verified phone, or if the phone is already linked to another account.
